title: Preserve authored legato and slur endpoints
scope: Add authored legato/slur state without reusing hammer or slide flags for unrelated relationships.
acceptance: Retain Beat.Legato in the numbered fixture and verify exact origin locations.
Show valid source evidence for any separate note slur endpoints before adding their public contract.
Test a supported slur across beats and an excerpt boundary; preserve independent consumer state and mutable occurrence ownership.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[39].voices[0].beats[0].isLegatoOrigin. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.

resolution: Beat.Legato now preserves GPIF beat-level origin and destination endpoints in an occurrence-owned BeatLegato record, including origin-only and destination-only excerpt boundaries. GP8 writes both exact attributes, malformed or missing attributes produce scoped invalid-data diagnostics, and focused tests cover the numbered fixture chain, reused beat definitions, post-parse edits, Go reimport, exact wire values, and pinned AlphaTab origin plus derived-destination consumption. No note-level slur field was added because the scoped source review found no separate authored source contract.
